Before such ground is reused, it must be inspected for bodily remains, and throwing even a small dead bone on the ground, if grease or marrow reaches the soil, also incurs punishment.","language":"English","quote_policy":"summarized"},"literal_observations":[{"id":"obs:1","text":"Ahura Mazda is said not to allow waste of anything valuable, even a very small amount of two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-karana.","category":"other","evidence_refs":["ev:5"]},{"id":"obs:8","text":"To make the ground fit for tilling again, people must inspect it for bones, hair,
